layers.description: Pytest and Vitest suites that verify API, CLI, analysis, research, model-adapter, UI, validation, scoring, export, and security behavior.

layers.name: Infrastructure and Configuration
layers.description: Container topology, CI, development launchers, environment settings, package manifests, build tools, repository templates, and knowledge-graph configuration.
